title: Teleportez
description: Instant teleportation without portals. Save your favorite locations and jump back with a single click.
body:
Tired of walking back to your base, your mines, or that village across the world?

Teleportez lets you teleport instantly to saved points.

Craft the Teleporter and open its menu in any of three ways:

Right-click with the Teleporter in hand...
Or Press the configurable hotkey (default: H, rebindable in Options → Controls).
Wear the Teleporter in a Curios slot (charm slot) and press the hotkey — requires the optional Curios API mod


From the menu you can:
- Create a teleport point that saves your rounded X / Y / Z coordinates and your facing direction (North, South, East, West).
- Teleport to any saved point.
- Rename and recolor points.
- Delete points you no longer need.


Curios support is fully optional — the mod works on its own, and simply adds the wearable slot when Curios is installed.
